column1: # 2026-10-12-967ag: every token that still says phase, with its category and why. Read by
# SpecWordRuleTests. Columns: token, reach, category, reason (tab-separated).
#   reach    anywhere = the token carries its meaning and may stand in any file;
#            listed   = the token cannot tell its meanings apart and may stand only where
#                       spec-word-files.tsv lists it, at most as often as it says.
#   category G2 another meaning (execution stage, triage stage, skill workflow step, pod phase,
#               UI state) and stays; STORED-967ab a stored or served name 967ab renames (none left);
#               ALIAS-967ah a reader of the old name 967ah removes; LABEL a tracker word or
#               config key read for good; HISTORY a name that records history and never
#               changes; MIXED a bare word whose meaning the file decides.
# A row whose token occurs nowhere fails as stale: delete it.
